description: Approved AI development skills and tools for featcache. AI agents must only use skills listed here and follow the validation steps.

required_skills.name: golang-testing
required_skills.purpose: table-driven tests, coverage, CI testing patterns

required_skills.name: golang-code-style
required_skills.purpose: Go style conventions: line breaks, comments, control flow

required_skills.name: golang-naming
required_skills.purpose: Go naming conventions (packages, functions, errors, receivers)

required_skills.name: golang-performance
required_skills.purpose: hot-path optimization for the zero-copy read path

required_skills.name: golang-benchmark
required_skills.purpose: benchmark methodology for read-path latency measurements

required_skills.name: golang-security
required_skills.purpose: shared memory and socket security review

prohibited_actions: editing .golangci.yml to mask lint warnings without justification
disabling or deleting tests to pass CI
locks or syscalls on the read path (violates architecture)
changes outside the scope of the assigned task
coding_standards: godoc comments on all exported identifiers
no locks/syscalls on the read path
build tags: linux (real impl) + !linux (stubs) must stay in sync
new code ships with tests; coverage never decreases
review_requirements: human review required before any PR submission
PR description discloses AI usage scope (see AI_CONTRIBUTING.md)
maintainers review at normal standards — AI generation does not lower the bar
